review:
Jane Hunter and the Mask of Montezuma introduces a new protagonist to the Hunter universe. It is a 5x3, 10-payline slot set in an ancient Aztec city, with binoculars, backpacks and pickaxes among the symbols and an atmospheric soundtrack behind them.

Three Aztec tomb scatters open the bonus with 10 free spins. During the round, each high-paying symbol on screen awards an instant cash prize whenever a collector symbol is present, and a progress meter above the reels unlocks further rewards as you collect enough of them. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a maximum win. The RTP is 96.02%, a little lower than most series entries.
